DSN 2026 spoken language identification: training data
	

Training and validation data for the DSN 2026 AI Bootcamp competition Find the Language I Am Speaking. The task: given a short audio clip, predict which of 12 Nigerian languages is spoken, or other. The hidden test set is not part of this dataset.

	
		
	
	
		Contents
	


data/train-*.parquet (24774 clips) and data/validation-*.parquet (4352 clips).
